test_title: PYST 42: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Amateur
solution:
The correct answer is **"Professional"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** We will learn the meaning of the antonym:

__
 
• **Amateur - **taking part in an activity for pleasure, not as a job

 
 
• ***Eg. ***He was an* amateur* singer until the age of 40, when he turned professional
 
 
 
• **Professional - **relating to work that needs special training or education
 
 
• ***Eg.*** Chris, you're a nurse, so can I ask your* professional *opinion on bandaging ankles?
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will see the meaning of the other given words:

 
• **Hospitable - **friendly and welcoming to guests and visitors

 
 
• ***Eg. ***The villagers were very *hospitable* to/towards anyone who passed through. 
 
 
 
• **Pupil -** a person, especially a child at school, who is being taught
 
 
• ***Eg. ***Her school report described her as a very promising* pupil.*
 
 
 
• **Scholar -** a person who studies a subject in great detail, especially at a university
 
 
• ***Eg.*** Dr Miles was a distinguished *scholar *of Russian history.
